<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Context brief. New pure module crates/daemon/src/community/templates.rs: a Catalog of (name, version, bytes), shipped() embeds every templates/roles/<name>/v<n>/role.dd.json with include_bytes! (as layout.rs does for schemas); tests inject fixture catalogs through DirectoryService::with_templates, so new() call sites are unchanged. http/directory.rs: add takes --from template:<name>[@v<n>] (template document, meta.id set, flags override through role::apply_fields) or --from file:<brief> (= --brief); new leaves templates and template-diff <id>. community/directory.rs view: per-role template drift and the C22/C26 prompts. pij_core::directory help gains the new verbs; the CLI renders templates, template-diff and prompts. The shim forwards directory argv unchanged, so no TS. Tests: role.rs and templates.rs units; crates/daemon/tests/directory_http.rs over HTTP with scratch repos, FakeDdocs, plus a real-ddocs case that skips when ddocs is absent. Hazards: shared seams with other lanes (directory.rs, cli main.rs, skills/pij) kept minimal; own target with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 and -p.
